export declare class XpmInputError extends Error

## Remarks

This error is thrown when command-line arguments, configuration values, or other user-provided input fails validation. Common scenarios include invalid property values, missing required fields, circular inheritance references, or out-of-range parameter values. The error message should clearly indicate what input was invalid and why, helping users correct their configuration or arguments.
